playstyle: Classic Mishima rushdown. Use the Flash Punch Combo and Wind God Fist to punish, wavedash into Fujin (FUJ) and the hellsweep, and pressure with plus moves like f+4 and the Raijin stance. Heat builds Ultimate Counts towards Warrior Instinct (WAR). Wavu warns his generic pokes are linear and most lows are launch punishable.

stances.name: Wind God Step
stances.note: Mishima crouch dash: Wind God Fist and Thunder God Fist come from here.

stances.name: Fujin
stances.entry: d+1+2, or D after f+3, f+4
stances.note: FUJ.1,1 is a Heat Engager; FUJ.2 (Hidden Wind God Fist) tornadoes. In Heat, Fujin auto-parries mids and highs (Wavu).

stances.name: Raijin
stances.note: RAI.2 is a homing high that guard-breaks and is +10 on block.

stances.name: Warrior Instinct
stances.entry: 1+4, or three Ultimate Counts in Heat
stances.note: Powers up moves: df+2,WAR.1 tornadoes, WAR.f,F+2 has more range.

keyMoves: Flash Punch Combo-style i10 string, -12 on block if all three finish.
His i10 punish that can be hit-confirmed.
-12 when the whole string is blocked.
Demon Breath: i12 mid, -10 on block, launches on hit (+24a).
Chrome Dome: i12 high headbutt, -14 on block.
An i12 punisher that leads to a follow-up launch in Heat or Warrior Instinct (Wavu).
Punish, then cash in with Heat.
Wind God Fist: i11 high, -10 on block; becomes the EWGF in Heat (Wavu).
Fast launch punisher and whiff punisher.
Practise the input until it is automatic.
Raoh Thrust: i13 mid Heat Engager, -8 on block.
A fast, safe mid that starts Heat.
Ascension Upper: i15 tornado from crouch, -14 on block.
After blocking lows that are -15 or worse.
Quick Iron Fist: i13 while-standing mid, -14 on block.
Right Splits Kick: i19 mid, +4 on block, can enter FUJ.
Lightning Crush: i18 knee, -5 on block, can enter FUJ.
A safe mid with a stance follow-up.
Otoko Geri: i15 high, tornadoes on counter hit (+52a).
A CH launcher that can be charged.
Sacred Tree Fell: i16 low, -13 on block.
Wavu: most of his lows are risky.
Thunder Cutter: i17 homing high from Raijin, +10 on block.
From Raijin to keep the turn.
i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch on break.

combos.name: Launch BnB: 4 T! uf+3,4 1,b+2,4
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as f,F+3 (Left Splits Kick).
mistakes: Pressing 4 too late: it must hit before they fall.
